description: This file defines the CriteriaFactory interface, which provides methods to create various criteria objects used for query filtering, such as logical combinations (and, or, nor), existence checks, and comparison predicates (eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, like, in). It serves as a builder for constructing query criteria in the Eclipse Ditto model.

classes.name: CriteriaFactory
classes.description: An interface providing method signatures to create criteria objects for querying documents, including logical, existence, and comparison operators.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Creates a Criteria which matches any document.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Creates a Criteria which performs a logical AND of the given criterias.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Creates a Criteria which performs a logical OR of the given criterias.

methods.name: nor
methods.description: Creates a Criteria which performs a logical NOR of the given criterias.

methods.name: nor
methods.description: Default method to create a NOR criterion from a single Criteria.

methods.name: fieldCriteria
methods.description: Creates a criteria to filter based on a certain field value using a predicate.

methods.name: existsCriteria
methods.description: Creates a criterion to check for the existence of a specific field.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Creates a predicate that checks for equality with the given value.

methods.name: ne
methods.description: Creates a predicate that checks for inequality with the given value.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Creates a predicate that checks if the field is greater than the given value.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Creates a predicate that checks if the field is greater than or equal to the given value.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Creates a predicate that checks if the field is less than the given value.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Creates a predicate that checks if the field is less than or equal to the given value.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Creates a predicate similar to SQL's LIKE, checking pattern match.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates a predicate that checks if the field value is within a list of specified values.
